summary: Accelerate software delivery with our 5-day Modern SDLC course. Learn DevOps, DevSecOps, and GitOps to optimize engineering performance. Enroll today.
lede: Modern software development lifecycle (SDLC) practices connect planning, coding, testing, security and deployment in continuous delivery workflows. Designed for experienced technical professionals, this course addresses the practical challenge of coordinating reliable software releases while managing rapid change and technical debt. Participants work with CI/CD and GitOps pipelines, automated testing and security checks, and cloud infrastructure and observability.
audienceIntro: This program is tailored for experienced technical professionals who are responsible for the design, execution, and optimization of software delivery processes within their organizations.
audience: Systems Reliability Engineers focused on deployment stability
prerequisites: Participants should have at least 3 years of experience in software development, systems administration, or technical project management. Familiarity with Git version control and basic Linux command-line operations is required. No advanced coding skills are necessary, but a working knowledge of at least one programming language (e.g., Python, Java, JavaScript) will enhance the learning experience.
